title: OL-20261125-1: Seed template workflows can only be synced by a credential with workflows scope
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** daily cleanroom run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation coherence --check --remote
**Status:** open

kit-sync runs on the built-in token, which GitHub refuses for workflow files, so ultrastable/seed workflows drift until a session or the tick Worker App pushes them. coherence --check --remote in cleanroom.yml goes red when they differ.
title: OL-20261125-1: Scratch bootstrap tenants are not torn down
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** daily seed-launch.yml run
**Done check:** file:foundation/seedlaunch.py
**Status:** open

seedlaunch --e2e-scratch leaves a Worker and D1 per day; site worker has no delete route. Add a scoped delete for bootproof-* names in site/deployer.js and call it after the probe. Also audit other repos and the Cloudflare account for hand-made resources.
